BUSINESS OVERVIEW

UGE International Inc. is a New York-based distributed-energy platform that develops, builds, finances, owns and operates community and commercial solar and battery-storage projects in the United States. NOVA Infrastructure completed the take-private of predecessor UGE International Ltd. on August 15, 2024 through NOVA-Swift Holdco, LP; the business subsequently continued to Delaware as UGE International Inc. NOVA continues to identify UGE as a Fund II platform, and no later sale or signed ownership transfer was found through September 1, 2026. Project SPVs, tax-equity vehicles, lenders and acquired development rights remain beneath the single platform boundary.

STORY TIMELINE
Jun 2025
Acquisition

UGE acquired development rights to 122 solar projects, including approximately 60 MWdc of late-stage New York projects and 2.35 GW of early-stage projects across 14 states.

Jan 2025
Expansion

UGE reported a 24 MW operating portfolio across six U.S. states.

Aug 22, 2024

The transaction survivor continued to Delaware and adopted the UGE International Inc. name.

Aug 15, 2024
Investment

NOVA Infrastructure completed the take-private of UGE International Ltd. through NOVA-Swift Holdco, LP.

May 29, 2024
Investment

UGE International Ltd. announced a definitive agreement to be acquired by a NOVA Infrastructure Fund II affiliate.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

I-595 Express, LLC is the concessionaire for the approximately 10.5-mile I-595 managed-lane corridor in Broward County, Florida.

The company financed, designed and built the improvements and operates and maintains the corridor under a 35-year availability-payment DBFOM agreement with the Florida Department of Transportation. TIAA/Nuveen owns 87.5% through I 595 Toll Road, LLC and the TIAA General Account, while ACS/Iridium retains 12.5%. No later equity transfer or signed pending sale was identified through September 1, 2026. FDOT, the roadway and managed lanes, contractors, operators, lenders, noteholders and financing SPVs are counterparties or components rather than separate PortCos.

STORY TIMELINE
Dec 10, 2019
Acquisition

TIAA acquired an additional 37.5% interest from ACS, producing the current 87.5%/12.5% ownership split.

Sep 5, 2014
Expansion

FDOT granted final acceptance and the corridor entered its long-term operations-and-maintenance phase.

Dec 7, 2011
Financing

TIAA acquired a 50% interest in the concessionaire through I 595 Toll Road, LLC.

Mar 3, 2009
Investment

I-595 Express, LLC executed and financially closed the 35-year DBFOM concession with ACS/Iridium as the original equity owner.
